<function name="GetLightness" parent="Color" type="classfunc">
	<description>Converts a <page>Color</page> into [HSL color space](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV) and returns the ["lightness"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lightness) of the color.

See <page>COLOR:ToHSL</page> if you want to get all 3 components.
</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2025.01.23</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="lightness" type="number">Lightness in range [0, 1]</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
